rows.text: Pay the waterbend by tapping Kilo and an artifact: you draw three without discarding, and Kilo proliferates. From turn 4 it is your best draw spell.

rows.name: Vigilancia universal
rows.text: Bad early. Late, pay {U}{U}{U} with rocks of any color and the X by tapping idle artifacts and Kilo (he proliferates); with Empowered Autogenerator it draws 6 to 10.

rows.name: Jhoira, capitana del Vientoligero
rows.text: Cast it on turn 4 or 5 before a batch of artifacts: it draws a card for each artifact or legendary you cast, which is more than a third of the deck. If you have spare mana, Relic of Legends taps her for mana. Organic Extinction kills her.

rows.name: Monitor de pensamientos
rows.text: With 4 to 6 artifacts it costs 1 to 3: two cards and a flying artifact that loads Long-Range Sensor. Meticulous Excavation returns it so you can draw again.

rows.name: Maga del trofeo
rows.text: Searches for an artifact with mana value 3. Early: Solar Array or Relic of Legends; with the engine running: Insight Engine or Surge Conductor; against artifact sweepers: Inspirit. It also reaches Uthros Research Craft, Long-Range Sensor, Patrolling Peacemaker, Commander's Sphere and Titan Forge.

rows.name: Emry, acechadora del lago
rows.text: With several artifacts she costs {U} or nothing. From the next turn, each turn she recasts from the graveyard Chromatic Star or Soul-Guide Lantern (one card for one mana), or a finisher that was destroyed or discarded. If her mill throws a finisher away, get it back with her.

rows.name: Espadas en guadañas
rows.text: Your best answer: for {W} and at instant speed, against the commander or the creature that beats you. Don't spend it on minor threats.

rows.name: Despachar
rows.text: From turn 3, with three artifacts, exile a creature for {W} at instant speed. Without metalcraft it only taps an attacker: keep it until you have the artifacts.

rows.name: Ausencia fatídica
rows.text: Instant for {1}{W} against a creature or planeswalker. The Clue its controller gets matters little: use it against the table's leader.

rows.name: Distorsión caótica
rows.text: Your answer to any permanent: enchantments or artifacts that shut down your artifacts, and indestructible commanders. Use it on whatever you can't answer any other way.

rows.name: Lección de control del aire
rows.text: Exile a nonland permanent and draw: best against tokens, permanents with counters or enter-the-battlefield effects, because the owner can cast it again for {2}. On defense, exile your own Kilo in response to removal and recast him from exile for {2}.

rows.name: Carga voltaica
rows.text: 3 damage to any target and a proliferate, all at instant speed: it kills a small creature at the end of a turn, or takes the Reactor from 19 to 20 in response to removal.

rows.name: Sedar
rows.text: Shuts down the commander or the best creature of a rival without changing its zone, so it doesn't return to the command zone. Each proliferate adds a stun counter to it: as long as you keep doing that, it doesn't untap.

rows.name: Cañón de luz
rows.text: Cast it through Solar Array with four colors: it enters with 4 counters and destroys a permanent that same turn. Afterward, tap it each turn for a counter and proliferate it to fire every one or two turns; North Pole Patrol untaps it.

rows.name: Fragua de titanes
rows.text: A charge-counter battery: charge it with {3} when mana is spare, and proliferate it. With three counters, a 9/9 Golem against big creatures; late, its charge goes to the Reactor with Moxite Refinery or Resourceful Defense. Target for Trophy Mage.

rows.name: Negar
rows.text: Save it for the winning turn or for the sweeper that takes you out of the game; it also protects the Reactor from an instant exile. Never on a minor spell.

rows.name: Ondas de potencial
rows.text: In response to a sweeper or removal: proliferate and phase out everything that got a counter until your next turn (Kilo needs a counter first). On the winning turn it is a shield and an extra proliferate at once.

rows.name: Extinción orgánica
rows.text: Pay for it almost entirely with improvise, tapping artifacts and Kilo (he proliferates). It kills only nonartifact creatures: your artifact creatures survive, but you lose Tekuthal, Jhoira, Reckless Fireweaver and Emry. Use it when the table loses more than you.

rows.name: Invocación estelar
rows.text: A total board wipe for when you're losing on creatures. Promise the gift to the least dangerous rival and return your best dead creature: Kilo (if you let him go to the graveyard he comes back without tax), Tekuthal or Alibou. Your rocks, the Reactor and the Artillery are not touched.

rows.name: Farol guía de almas
rows.text: On entering it exiles the key card of a rival's graveyard. Sacrifice it to exile every rival graveyard against a reanimator, or for {1} to draw if you don't need that. Emry recasts it.

rows.name: Torre de mando
rows.text: Kilo's three colors from turn 1; it doesn't make black or green.

rows.name: Yermos de Adarkar
rows.text: White or blue, untapped for 1 life; colorless for free when you don't need color.

rows.name: Arrecife shivano
rows.text: Blue or red, untapped for 1 life; colorless for free when you don't need color.

rows.name: Cascada de azufre
rows.text: Blue or red; it enters untapped with an Island or Mountain on the battlefield, so play it from turn 2 on.

rows.name: Fortaleza glacial
rows.text: White or blue; it enters untapped with a Plains or Island on the battlefield, so play it from turn 2 on.

rows.name: Refugio en la cima
rows.text: Red or white; it enters untapped with a Mountain or Plains on the battlefield, so play it from turn 2 on.

rows.name: Cima radiante
rows.text: Red or white; it enters untapped with two basic lands on the battlefield: save it for turn 3 or later.

rows.name: Pradera escabrosa
rows.text: Filter: with one red or white mana it gives {R}{R}, {R}{W} or {W}{W}, for Kilo, Alibou and Starfall Invocation.

rows.name: Riscos de la cascada
rows.text: Filter: with one blue or red mana it gives {U}{U}, {U}{R} or {R}{R}, for Tekuthal and Universal Surveillance.

rows.name: Huerto exótico
rows.text: It gives the colors of the rivals' lands: often black or green, the fourth color for Crystalline Crawler and Etched Oracle.

rows.name: Chapitel de la industria
rows.text: With an artifact on the battlefield it gives any color for 1 life, black or green included; without artifacts, only colorless.

rows.name: Sede del sínodo
rows.text: Blue and an artifact: it counts for Dispatch, affinity and improvise, and makes Surge Conductor proliferate. It dies to artifact sweepers.

rows.name: Guarida antigua
rows.text: White and an artifact: it counts for Dispatch, affinity and improvise, and makes Surge Conductor proliferate.

rows.name: Gran horno
rows.text: Red and an artifact: it counts for Dispatch, affinity and improvise, and makes Surge Conductor proliferate.

rows.name: Puente valleoxidado
rows.text: Enters tapped: play it on turn 1. Red or white, an artifact, and indestructible: it survives the sweepers that destroy.

rows.name: Bastión de Karn
rows.text: Late, {4} and tap it: one more proliferate per turn (two with Tekuthal). Use it at the end of the turn of the opponent before you with the spare mana.

rows.name: Los Jardines de Micosintético
rows.text: Early, {1} and tap it: any color, black or green for Crystalline Crawler. Late, {4} and tap it: it becomes a second Lux Artillery; it also copies Surge Conductor or Insight Engine (X=3). Never copy Everflowing Chalice, Pentad Prism or Astral Cornucopia: their copied X is worth 0.

rows.name: Monasterio místico
rows.text: Enters tapped with Kilo's three colors: play it on turn 1 or 2.

rows.name: Senda de los ancestros
rows.text: Enters tapped with Kilo's three colors: play it on turn 1 or 2; its scry almost never triggers.

rows.name: Isla
rows.text: Basic blue source; it enables Sulfur Falls, Glacial Fortress and Radiant Summit.

rows.name: Llanura
rows.text: Basic white source; it enables Glacial Fortress, Clifftop Retreat and Radiant Summit.

rows.name: Montaña
rows.text: Basic red source; it enables Sulfur Falls, Clifftop Retreat and Radiant Summit.
